text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.
- Members of a special anti-drugs force operating in the north of Portugal have been accused of crimes including drug trafficking, criminal association and corruption.

- More than 90 percent of Portuguese forestry companies are making losses and have delayed salary payments, the forestry association ANEFA-Associacao Nacional dos Empreiteiros Florestais e Agricolas told the paper.
- Gas company Transgas, which holds the concession for the natural gas network, is to invest between five and 7.5 billion escudos in the construction of a storage facility.
- The European Commission has proposed a rise in fuel taxes, which represents an increase of 15 escudos in the diesel price in Portugal.
